groups.criterion_quote: while they are at the registered establishment

source_evidence.quote: Prescribed plants and plant products prepared at a registered establishment must be traced:
(b) while they are at the registered establishment; and

groups.reason: 4-7B(b) is a specific sub-requirement of the general tracing requirement in 4-7B, narrowing the temporal scope to 'while they are at the registered establishment'.

source_evidence.quote: while they are at the registered establishment
The integrity of prescribed plants or plant products prepared at a registered establishment must be ensured while the plants or plant products are at the establishment.

groups.reason: Both provisions address the same temporal scope of the criterion, with 4-7B(b) focusing on traceability and 4-8 on integrity, jointly supporting the requirement that controls apply while plants/products are at the establishment.

rationale_summary: 4-7B(b) specializes the general tracing requirement of 4-7B. 4-7B(b) and 4-8 support the same criterion by addressing traceability and integrity respectively within the same temporal scope.
